caption: The digit 5 is the group field: 4 + 1 = r-x. Bob is in group exam, so that field is used — he can read and execute the file, but not write it.

spec.title: mode 754
spec.aria: Mode 754 splits into 7 for the owner (rwx), 5 for the group (r-x) and 4 for others (r--); bob is in group exam, so the group field r-x is used, giving read and execute but not write.
